name: REBELLO, Leon

headline.note: Follow-up adds Wallace office2016–17, Bishop office month boundaries, KWM summer clerkship2016–17 and volunteer roles. Clerkship/staff overlap unresolved. Later KWM hours, campaign leave and precise dates remain unknown; ACT admission confirmed without exact date. Study, nonprofit governance, volunteering, political staffing and elected office excluded; no reliable totals.

career_spells.employer: Australian National University; overseas exchange institutions; legal-practice provider to reconcile
career_spells.role: Law, international relations and legal-practice student
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biography identifies ANU law/international-relations degrees and legal-practice diploma. Public profile lists College of Law2019 but obscures credential; reconcile provider rather than silently replacing ANU. ANU student-authored blog confirms Utrecht University exchange in2016 and departure from Australia22December2015. France/China study retained from primary organisation biography; exact dates/providers remain incomplete.

career_spells.employer: Australian Parliament — employing department to confirm
career_spells.evidence_note: Rebello's member biography and first speech describe work as a parliamentary attendant sorting mail and supporting the House chamber. In a 2026 interview he said he was about 19, and a later post described the work as roughly ten years before 2025. Exact dates, hours, employment basis and leave are unpublished. Revisited member biography and speech confirm attendant/mail work but do not name employing department. Earlier record assigned Department of Parliamentary Services without an explicit supporting passage; retain that as a verification lead, not established employer identity.
career_spells.counting_note: Public employment is supported, but no countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Minister for Foreign Affairs, the Hon. Julie Bishop MP
career_spells.evidence_note: Public professional-profile index explicitly dates Julie Bishop office July2017–September2018. Earlier sources confirm the role; title, full-time status, leave and exact day boundaries remain unverified.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.role: Solicitor, specialising in foreign investment law
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography says only 'Solicitor'. Rebello and party profiles identify King & Wood Mallesons and foreign-investment specialization; a March 2025 Lawyers Weekly profile says he had worked there for the past six years and remained a solicitor while campaigning. Exact start, admission, hours, leave, secondments and cessation are unpublished. Public first-person post confirms admission in ACT Supreme Court, but only relative publication age accessible; no exact date inferred.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantive private legal work is clear, but an approximate aggregate duration does not establish a precise continuous full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Multicultural Communities Council Gold Coast / Cura Aged Care
career_spells.evidence_note: The organisation's 2023–24 and 2024–25 annual reports list Rebello as a director and describe his legal and ministerial-staff background. Appointment/cessation, remuneration and time commitment are not provided. Current primary board page still lists him and identifies his parliamentary office.2025was an annual-report year, not sourced cessation; removed as boundary. No paid job inferred.
Official records show election to the House of Representatives for McPherson on 3 May 2025.

career_spells.evidence_note: Self-reported profile dates office August2016–July2017; first-person post confirms departure to Bishop. Hours/title unknown. KWM clerkship overlaps; no assumption of simultaneous full-time jobs.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.
